intro: Do'gol has rubbed the shield clear enough to see what appears to spell Mosarn, a name that means nothing to Do'gol. Krog in Brackenwall Village knows many people, so Do'gol sends you to ask there.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, I think I might have dropped too much acid onto the shield. Let me just rub a little...
Hm, kind of hard to read, but it looks like the name Mosarn. Never heard of him. Maybe Krog knows. Krog knows many people.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mosarn? Sounds familiar... I can't put my finger on it. Maybe it'll come to me later.
It probably isn't important. A shield can come from anywhere and not mean anything...
